description: Get one SportPoint club by slug (from search_clubs_and_places): description, places, coaches, and one Monday-to-Sunday week of its sessions with price in EUR and spots left. Pass week as any date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the wanted week; the default is the current week.

slug.description: The club slug, as returned by search_clubs_and_places.

week.description: Any date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the week to show. Defaults to the current week.

name: get_club
title: Get Club
